# AVFAudio

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 58.1% of Apple's iOS API (843 of 1450, exact) · **Rows:** 10: 8 ✅ 2 ❌ · **iOS:** 14.5+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [AVFAudio](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfaudio) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** implemented inside isim's AVFoundation overlay (`AVAudioEngine.swift`, `AVFoundation.swift`): the audio graph, players, recorders, sessions and speech synthesis (espeak-ng). Rows for the classes: [AVFoundation](AVFoundation.md).
- **Module:** `import AVFAudio` is a module that re-exports AVFoundation (`isim/swift/overlays/AVFAudio.swift`): on iOS AVFoundation re-exports AVFAudio, in isim both names reach the same classes.
- **Objective-C:** `<AVFAudio/AVFAudio.h>` imports AVFoundation's header, and `AVFAudio.framework` re-exports `AVFoundation.framework` (`isim/sdk-src/Frameworks/AVFAudio`). Since [#553](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues/553) its headers (`AVAudioFormat.h`, `AVAudioBuffer.h`, `AVAudioConverter.h`, `AVAudioFile.h`, `AVAudioEngine.h`, `AVAudioNode.h` and the node and unit headers, `AVAudioPlayer.h`, `AVAudioRecorder.h`, …) declare the engine, nodes, formats, buffers, converter, file, player and recorder over the overlay's classes, which are `@objc(AVAudio…)` with Apple's selectors. Swift-only members (enums, option sets, the `AVAudio3D…` structs) have internal Objective-C entry points (`AVFAudioObjC.swift`) and categories in `AVFoundation.framework`.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `import AVFAudio` | ✅ | 14.5 | adapted: re-exports isim's AVFoundation, so it brings AVFoundation's other names too. Tested (HelloAudioModules) |
| `#import <AVFAudio/AVFAudio.h>`, `-framework AVFAudio` | ✅ | 14.5 | adapted: AVFoundation's Objective-C header (`AVAudioSession` and the rest of what isim declares there). Tested (AudioHeadersTest) |
| Objective-C: `AVAudioFormat`, `AVAudioChannelLayout`, `AVAudioTime`, `AVAudioPCMBuffer`, `AVAudioCompressedBuffer`, `AVAudioConverter` (buffer to buffer, input block, prime method / info), `AVAudioFile`, `AVAudioEngine` (connections, manual rendering and its block), `AVAudioNode` and its subclasses (player, mixer, input / output, source, sink, environment with the `AVAudio3D…` structs, the unit effects and time effects, generator), `AVAudioMixing`, `AVAudioPlayer`, `AVAudioRecorder` and their delegates, the settings keys, `AVAudioEngineConfigurationChangeNotification` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the Swift classes under Apple's Objective-C names and selectors (`AVFAudioObjC.swift`, `frameworks/AVFoundation/AVFoundation.m`); the classes are not subclassable from Objective-C. Tested (AVFAudioObjCTest: formats, conversion and AAC, a WAV file, an offline engine with EQ / reverb / source / 3D environment nodes, a player and a recorder with their delegates) |
| `AVAudioConverter`: `init(from:to:)`, `convert(to:from:)`, `convert(to:error:withInputFrom:)` (`AVAudioConverterInputBlock`, `AVAudioConverterInputStatus`, `AVAudioConverterOutputStatus`), `reset`, `channelMap`, `downmix`, `dither`, `sampleRateConverterQuality` / `Algorithm`, `primeMethod` / `primeInfo`, `magicCookie`, `bitRate`, `bitRateStrategy`, `maximumOutputPacketSize`, the available / applicable encode bit rates, sample rates and channel layout tags | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted on AudioToolbox's AudioConverter: linear PCM (sample format, interleaving, channels, sample rate) in Swift, AAC encoding and AAC / MP3 decoding passthrough to the host's libavcodec; `convert(to:from:)` does not resample (as on iOS); `noDataNow` gives `inputRanDry` and the next call continues; dither, priming and the resampler's quality / algorithm are kept but not applied (one resampler); AAC encodes at a constant bit rate; tested (HelloAudio -engine: Int16 interleaved, downmix, channel map, 48 → 24 kHz, no data now, AAC round trip) |
| `AVAudioCompressedBuffer` (`packetCapacity`, `packetCount`, `maximumPacketSize`, `data`, `byteCapacity`, `byteLength`, `packetDescriptions`), `AVAudioBuffer.audioBufferList` / `mutableAudioBufferList`, `AVAudioFormat` for compressed formats (`init(settings:)` with `AVFormatIDKey`, `init(streamDescription:)`, `magicCookie`, `formatDescription`, `init(cmAudioFormatDescription:)`) | ✅ | ≤17 | packets with their descriptions, as the converter fills and reads them; compressed formats have `commonFormat == .otherFormat`; tested (HelloAudio -engine: AAC packets) |
| `AVAudioPCMBuffer` in every common format: `int16ChannelData`, `int32ChannelData`, interleaved `floatChannelData`, `stride`, `init(pcmFormat:bufferListNoCopy:deallocator:)`, copies | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: Int16 / Int32 / Float64 and interleaved buffers have storage in their own layout (isim before 0.26 stored every buffer as deinterleaved floats); the engine and files read them through a float view; `bufferListNoCopy` copies the samples; tested (HelloAudio -engine) |
| `AVAudioChannelLayout` (`init(layoutTag:)`, `init(layout:)`, `layoutTag`, `layout`, `channelCount`, secure coding), `AVAudioFormat.channelLayout`, `init(standardFormatWithSampleRate:channelLayout:)`, `init(commonFormat:sampleRate:interleaved:channelLayout:)`, `init(streamDescription:channelLayout:)`, `AVChannelLayoutKey`; `AudioChannelLayout`, `AudioChannelDescription`, `AudioChannelBitmap`, the `kAudioChannelLayoutTag_…` and `kAudioChannelLabel_…` constants (Swift and C) | ✅ | ≤17 | Apple's values and layouts; a tag's channel count is its low 16 bits; tested (HelloAudio -engine: 5.1 through settings) |
| `AVAudioTime` | ✅ | ≤17 | a class (`NSObject`) as on iOS: sample time, host time, `extrapolateTime(fromAnchor:)`, `audioTimeStamp`; host times are nanoseconds of the uptime clock. isim before 0.26 had a struct: Swift apps that use `AVAudioTime` must be rebuilt (`isim/abi/allowlist.txt`); tested (HelloAudio -engine) |
| `AVAudioUnitTimeEffect`, `AVAudioUnitGenerator` | ✅ | ≤17 | `AVAudioUnitVarispeed` and `AVAudioUnitTimePitch` are time effects, as on iOS (isim before 0.26 made them `AVAudioUnitEffect`s; apps that use them must be rebuilt); `AVAudioUnit.instantiate` returns the class for the component type; adapted: isim has none of Apple's generator units (AUAudioFilePlayer, AUScheduledSoundPlayer), so a generator renders silence with its mixing settings; tested (HelloAudio -engine) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AVAudioSequencer`, `AVAudioUnitComponent`, `AVAudioUnitComponentManager`, `AVAudioUnitMIDIInstrument`, `AVAudioUnitSampler`, `AVMIDIPlayer`, `AVSpeechSynthesisProviderAudioUnit` (7 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AVReadOnlyAudioPCMBuffer` (1 type; with its members under "Not yet in isim") |
